description: PMSH - Áreas prioritárias - 5. Abastecimento de Água (eixo 3) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Camada temática que representa as áreas prioritárias relacionadas ao componente de Abastecimento de Água, no âmbito do Eixo 3 – Saneamento, Controle da Poluição e Obras Hídricas, do Plano Mineiro de Segurança Hídrica (PMSH). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are PMSH, Áreas prioritárias, Segurança hídrica, Ottobacias agregadas, ide_2412_mg_pmsh_areasprioritarias_indabast_uag_2023_pol. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
